blocks.text: Pani zindagi ki bunyaad hai. Yeh pani ki farahmi (hydration) aur safai ke zariye insanon ko zinda aur sehatmand rakhta, aur jism se zehreele maddey nikalta hai. Yeh paudon ko photosynthesis karne deta aur fasalon ki barhotri se zaraat ko sahara deta hai. Janwar jism ke kaamon ke tawazun ke liye is par inhisar karte hain, aur be-shumar khurdbeeni jandaar zinda rehne ke liye is par munhasir hain. Insani taraqqi, zaraat aur khurak ki hifazat sab pani ki mustaqil farahmi par munhasir hain.

Qudrat mein pani zameen ki shakal banata, mausam ko mutawazin rakhta aur zer-e-zameen zakhiron ko dobara bharta hai. Darya, jheelein, daldali ilaqe (wetlands) aur samandar jaise ecosystems mukhtalif paudon aur janwaron ki zindagi ke liye pani par inhisar karte hain. Pani tawanai ki paidawar, naql-o-hamal, shehri taraqqi aur science ki tehqeeq ke liye zaruri hai, aur pani ki qillat mahol, muashron aur maeeshat ke liye khatra hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen wajoohat batayein ke pani zindagi ke liye kyun zaruri hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi teen: insanon ko pani dena aur zehreele maddey nikalna; paudon ko photosynthesis ke liye chahiye; fasalon ki barhotri aur khurak ki hifazat; janwar jism ke kaamon ke tawazun ke liye; khurdbeeni jandaar aur ecosystems is par munhasir.

items: Pani sehat, paudon, janwaron, zaraat aur ecosystems ko sahara deta.
Qillat mahol, muashron aur maeeshat ke liye khatra.
